differences: Experiment 1 sample: the paper reports 39 women among the 52 final participants; the shared sex column gives 28 women and 24 men for the same 52 (age, 28.7 +- 6.9, reproduces).

Seven Experiment 1 rows hold only a participant identifier with no values (four of them are participants the paper excludes for poor audio); they are not copied. The script excludes one further participant who has 32 productions.

Tables 2 and 4 were refitted in Python. The Experiment 1 model of the authors has zero participant-intercept variance (a singular fit), so least squares gives their coefficients, SEs and t; Experiment 2 was refitted by REML with a random intercept and a random Response slope per participant. All agree with the printed values to the printed decimals; p-values were not refitted.
